unusual_events.explanation: Unusually large magnetic field: B_max = 12.5 nT (4.9σ above mean). Possible causes: magnetospheric compression, flux tube boundary, current sheet crossing, or reconnection inflow region.

Unusually steep magnetic power spectrum: α = -2.646 (much steeper than Kolmogorov α = -5/3 = -1.667). This indicates enhanced dissipation at sub-ion scales, possibly due to Landau damping of kinetic Alfvén waves or reconnection-driven turbulence. Active Langmuir/TSI waves can inject energy into the perpendicular direction, feeding into the turbulent cascade.
